headlines.description: Toronto FC got second-half stoppage-time goals from Lewis Morgan and Djordje Mihailovic to stun CF Montreal 2-1 on Saturday in the latest edition of the 401 Derby.
headlines.shortLinkText: Morgan, Mihailovic score in stoppage time and Toronto stuns Montreal

FC Cincinnati at Atlanta United FC

headlines.description: Kevin Denkey scored two goals after a scoreless first half and FC Cincinnati snapped a six-match winless streak with a 3-1 victory over Atlanta United on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Denkey's double sparks Cincinnati to win over Atlanta

events.name: D.C. United at Inter Miami CF

headlines.description: Lionel Messi scored two goals to give him a league-leading 23 this season, and Inter Miami CF beat D.C. United 4-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Messi, Suárez score braces as Miami routs D.C.

events.name: Seattle Sounders FC at New England Revolution

headlines.description: Seattle got goals from Hassani Dotson, Dejan Joveljić and Paul Arriola to back a clean sheet from Andrew Thomas and the Sounders extended their unbeaten run to nine with a 3-0 victory over the New England Revolution on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sounders extend unbeaten streak to 9 with victory over Revs

events.name: Columbus Crew at Orlando City SC

headlines.description: Iván Angulo scored the go-ahead goal in the 89th minute, Antoine Griezmann added a goal and an assist, and Maxime Crépeau had 12 saves to help Orlando City beat the Columbus Crew 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Angulo's stoppage-goal lifts Orlando past Columbus

events.name: Real Salt Lake at Philadelphia Union

headlines.description: Teenager Cavan Sullivan had assists on goals by Bruno Damiani and Milan Iloski to help the Philadelphia Union extend their club-record unbeaten streak to 13 with a 2-1 victory over Real Salt Lake on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cavan Sullivan's 2 assists help Union extend club-record unbeaten streak to 13
